news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems CEO and Director Exercise Stock Options
news.summary: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercised a fully-vested option for 1,402 shares at a $0.75 strike on July 22, and director Richard S. Kollender exercised options for 3,508 shares at the same price on July 24, ahead of the options' August 2026 expiration; no shares were sold in either filing.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems confirmed it will report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 7, 2026, followed by a management webcast conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems (RPID) Trefis analysis: shares down since Q1 miss, MilliporeSigma tie-up and onshoring trend cited as tailwinds
news.summary: Trefis noted RPID stock had fallen further since the disappointing Q1 2026 report, while pointing to the MilliporeSigma global distribution partnership and pharma reshoring/automation demand as potential 2026 growth drivers.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 60,000 restricted stock units of Class A common stock to a newly hired employee as a material inducement to employment, with the award vesting in three equal annual installments.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems will report second-quarter 2026 results before market open with an 8:30 a.m. ET webcast; investors will watch system placement pace, cash burn, and progress toward full-year guidance after shares have slid to multi-year lows near $1.70-$2.20 since the Q1 print.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue and placement guidance
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to $37M-$41M total revenue and 30-38 Growth Direct system placements for 2026 with roughly 20% gross margin; the August 7 Q2 report is the next test of whether the company is tracking to this range after a Q1 revenue beat paired with a wider-than-expected net loss and a dilutive ~$9.8M equity/warrant offering in May.

catalysts.label: MilliporeSigma distribution agreement, year two
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro is in year two of its five-year global co-exclusive distribution and collaboration agreement with MilliporeSigma (year two running roughly March 2026-February 2027), under which MilliporeSigma has a stated commitment to purchase Growth Direct systems; incremental orders under this plan year are a potential upside catalyst.

catalysts.label: Follow-on orders from anchor pharma accounts
catalysts.detail: Following large multi-system expansion orders from Amgen (Q4 2025) and Samsung Biologics (Q1 2026), additional follow-on orders from these and other big-pharma customers as they continue rolling out Growth Direct across sites remain a potential upside catalyst.

pulse: Rapid Micro Biosystems is a small-cap pharma-automation name (Growth Direct microbial QC platform) whose stock has kept sliding to fresh multi-year lows around $1.70-$2.20 since a disappointing Q1 2026 report and a dilutive ~$9.8M May equity/warrant offering, even as Trefis and Wall Street analysts (Stifel, KeyBanc, Lake Street -- all Buy/Overweight, though KeyBanc and Lake Street trimmed targets to $5-$7) point to the MilliporeSigma global distribution partnership and pharma reshoring/automation demand as 2026 tailwinds. News flow over the past six weeks has otherwise been light and largely administrative -- a routine employee inducement grant and insider option exercises by the CEO and a director -- with the August 7, 2026 Q2 earnings report the next real test of whether system placement momentum and the MilliporeSigma ramp are translating into progress toward full-year guidance of $37M-$41M revenue.
